newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine gov't still undecided on its YPF shares.
newsitem.headline: Argentine gov't still undecided on its YPF shares.

text.p: The Argentine government said Monday it has still not decided whether to sell its remaining shares in oil firm YPF SA.

"Despite studies that are being carried out, up to the moment no decision has been taken with regards to the possible sale or other form of use of the state's shareholding in the firm YPF SA," the Econonmy Ministry said in a statement.
"It is not considered that an urgent situation exists requiring the hasty sale of these shares," the ministry added. It said that any decision would aim to preserve YPF's share price.

Economy Minister Roque Fernandez last week told Congress that Argentina aimed to raise $1.0 billion from privatizations this year and that most of that revenue would come from the sale of the state's 20-percent YPF stake.
Fernandez's chief aide said Monday that the government was also studying using the shares as collateral for a loan of up to $1.0 billion.
